name: Ocean (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
A connection to the ocean is a connection to the water sources both big and small throughout the world. They are suffused with the life-giving energy of water.

Manifestation: The conduit’s connection to the ocean can manifest in many ways, a soft salty breeze around them, the smell of seaweed, the distant sound of gulls or crashing waves, they may even leave behind the occasional damp footprint.

Communing: Communing with the ocean could be watching the flows of water (tides or rivers), swirling unmoving water, letting rain fall on your face, swimming or stepping barefoot into a body of water.

Connection Spells: (1st-level/0th) – saltspray* (2nd-level/1st) – hydraulic push (4th-level/2nd) – waterwalk, communal (6th-level/3rd) – water breathing (8th-level/4th) – control water (10th-level/5th) – geyser (12th-level/6th) – solid fog (14th-level/7th) – steam ray fusillade (16th-level/8th) – seamantle (18th-level/9th) – tsunami

Added Spells to Learn: Spells with the water descriptor, spells that create or remove precipitation, fog, or water.

Primal Empathy: The conduit gains the ability to communicate with creatures that live in water. This includes animals, magical beasts, fey, and elementals as well as other creatures that make their homes in water at the GM’s discretion.

Natural Skill: Perception

Natural Movement: The conduit gains a 20-foot swim speed.

Aqueous Unity (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, so long as the conduit has 1 primal point remaining, they can breathe normally when submerged in water or would otherwise be drowning due to water.

Additionally, as a swift action, the conduit can expend a primal point to grant a touched target a 20-foot swim speed for 1 minute per class level. The conduit can target an additional target with a use of this ability at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels.

Buoyed by Currents (Su)

Starting with 5th level, so long as the conduit has 1 primal point remaining, they increase the swim speed of any allied creature within 30 feet by 50%, minimum 5 feet. This boost to their speed lasts until the end of the affected creature’s turn if they leave the radius. If the target does not have a swim speed, they instead gain a +8 bonus to their Swim checks.

Churning Waters (Sp)

Starting with 9th level, as a standard action, the conduit can summon up a waves of water to perform a reposition or bull rush combat maneuver against 1 creature per 3 class levels within 30 feet of them. For this combat maneuver, the conduit uses their Charisma modifier instead of their Strength modifier. If a target is in water at least 4 inches deep, the conduit uses their class level instead of their base attack bonus for the combat maneuver check against that target.

The conduit uses a single combat maneuver roll against all affected targets. Also, the combat maneuver can move the target in any direction so long as they were originally within the radius of the effect.

Drawing Water (Sp)

Starting with 13th level, the conduit can violently pull water out of a target. As a standard action, the conduit may target a single creature within 60 feet that has blood or is made of water. The target takes 1d8 damage per two class levels you possess and a Fortitude save halves this damage. If the target has the water subtype, the damage increases to 1d6 per class level. You can then use the drawn water to create difficult terrain in a 10-foot square within range. The difficult terrain remains for 1 hour or until exposed to fire damage like from a fireball.

Servant of the Surf (Ex)

At 17th level, the conduit no longer needs to have primal points remaining for the ongoing effects of the aqueous unity or buoyed by the currents abilities and churning waters always uses your class level instead of their base attack bonus for the combat maneuver.

Additionally, if the target is in water, you may roll the combat maneuver for churning waters twice and take the better result.
